issues.issue: Did the officer adequately justify the finding of misrepresentation, including rejecting the innocent mistake explanation?
issues.applicant_position: Officer gave only conclusory reasons; no finding on innocent mistake or why his answer was untruthful.
issues.respondent_position: Minister says officer concluded the omission was not innocent or honest; case is akin to Tuiran.
issues.result_quote: do not meet the requirements of a transparent and justified decision

issues.issue: Did the officer adequately justify that the omission was material?
issues.applicant_position: Materiality finding was brief and conclusory; no explanation of how the omission could affect the process.
issues.respondent_position: Minister says a foreign visa refusal is invariably material to a visa application, citing Mohseni.
issues.result_quote: this brief and fairly conclusory statement does not provide an adequate explanation
